title: Add `ledger export` for other tools
body: People want to get their ledger data out for use in other tools. Add an `export` command to the ledger CLI.
answers: Maintainer answers: (1) Formats: CSV and JSON, chosen with a required `--format csv|json`; no default. (2) Content: the entries themselves, not totals, sorted by date, with fields date, amount, category and note. The amount is the same two-decimal text `ledger list` shows (refunds negative, e.g. `-3.00`). (3) Destination: standard output by default; `--output FILE` writes the file instead and prints nothing to standard output; if FILE already exists the command fails with exit status 2 unless `--force` is given. (4) Errors: an unknown format, a missing `--format`, or a path that cannot be written is exit status 2 with a one-line message on stderr, never a traceback. (5) Shapes: CSV has the header row `date,amount,category,note` and quotes fields as needed; JSON is an object `{"version": 1, "entries": [...]}` whose entries use the same four field names.
